text: Yeah, it was the music that held us together White and yellow, red and black The tired puts us down Yeah, but we'll always be down to writing back I said I did not go to Princeton I did not go to Yale I did not go to Harvard, baby At least I didn't go to jail And I did not go to NYU Now I'm not gonna notice
